blocking_findings.why: All three evidence quotes are verbatim in the fixture (lines 30-31, 36-37, 41). The conflict is real: 'each one tagged' plus 'anything you leave out is lost' demands complete enumeration while 'Keep the whole report under 400 words.' is an unconditioned hard cap, and no precedence is stated. The Manifests scenario is in the description's own remit ('Use proactively for each minor or major bump'), and a two-major jump plausibly overflows 400 words, forcing one stated guarantee to break silently. Under rule 4 this is not inflated — a stated guarantee of the target is breached in the named scenario — though Medium vs Low is a defensible judgment call, the report defends it.

runner_deviations_affecting_grades: Step 1 over-read (head -20 pulled ~15 body lines into main context) and Step 6 whole-file spot-check instead of region reads: both disclosed, both context-discipline deviations on a 43-line file; neither changes any assertion grade.
Heredoc quoting artifact in one R7 advisory line repaired in place with python3; the evidence substance is unchanged and the quote still matches the fixture, so no grade is affected.
grader_summary: The run executed the full two-pass review correctly: real plugin agents for both passes, verified verbatim evidence, correct report shape, a properly computed verdict, and disciplined Low handling (Advisory-only, hedged, non-gating). It diverged from expected_output on assertion 1 by raising one Medium (C1): the fixture's complete-enumeration rule and its unconditioned 400-word cap genuinely conflict with no stated precedence, and the Manifests scenario sits inside the fixture's own declared remit — so this divergence is an eval-suite defect (the 'clean' fixture carries a latent rule conflict), not report-padding by the skill. Assertion 5's failure is a run/skill defect: the fixture's proactive phrasing and trigger-stating description are plainly present, yet the report never credits A5 or A3 — the Fit-for-purpose section discusses the description only for routing (A2), leaving a crediting coverage gap. Both criteria corpora loaded, all cited keys resolve, and no fabricated or inflated finding was detected.
